messages.author: 00fb4c08960da3b6
messages.subject: Error loading xlsx package
parts:
Hi

I already posted the question on stackoverflow, but the problem still
persists.

A couple of days ago we migrated to windows 7 in our firm and also
updated the java packages and also R (to 2.14) and office (to office
2010).

Then I tried to load the xlsx package, because I rely heavly on it but
i get the following error:
Error : .onAttach in attachNamespace()
Error: .jnew("org/apache/poi/xssf/usermodel/XSSFWorkbook")

Since I never work with java i have no clue what I can do. Can you
help me?

The interesting thing is, that the package XLConnect or Rcmdr loads
without problems. So maybe it is really no Java problem.

Can anyone help me?

Thank you!

messages.author: 1db601ea1fed90a0
messages.subject: Re: Error loading xlsx package
parts:
Hard to say. If it's still not working for you, try installing the
package from sources.

install.packages("xlsx_0.4.2.tar.gz", type="source")

That will do some more checks and may pinpoint the error.

If you fixed it, please send back what you did, in case it's useful to
somebody else .

Adrian

But the package is there and a path variable is set to the jvm.dll and a JAVA_HOME variable is set.
 
Do you have any ideas?
 
Thank you

messages.subject: Re: Error loading xlsx package
parts:
Hi Rainer, 

This is a different error from what you showed earlier (you are using R 2.15 but the previous sessionInfo shows R 2.14), but it is more precise.  Your installation of the rJava package is not OK.  Please install the rJava package correctly (run some example code from the package to make sure), and then I'm willing to bet that the xlsx package will work fine too. 

Best, 
Adrian
